title: project
description: Result of `stride project <YYYY-MM-DD> ["<date>=<target>,..."]` (ADR 0010): CTL/ATL/TSB on the target date, folded by the same recurrence daily_load runs — over the RECORDED open plan's structured targets (plan_source: recorded), or over a caller-passed hypothetical plan that REPLACES it in the walk (plan_source: hypothetical). The hypothetical is echoed back verbatim and never stored — the recorded plan stays the single source of adherence truth. stride never solves for the plan that reaches a target: plan to consequences only.

hypothetical.description: The caller's plan, echoed verbatim; empty for plan_source: recorded.
